classification.notes: The article describes a cyberattack on Bank Rakyat (a Malaysian bank), which is not a DTCC member or major US/global systemically important participant with a direct connection to DTCC processes. The attack involved website defacement only, with no indication of operational disruption to any DTCC-connected participant, settling bank, or critical infrastructure. The XE-CYBER card requires a cyberattack at a large DTCC participant or vendor; Bank Rakyat does not meet that threshold based on the article.
